## Welcome to PPADEM

[About the Project]{.ppadem-pill}

Political Parties and Democracy in Africa (PPADEM) is an ambitious, collaborative multi-year research project investigating the role of political parties in shaping democracy across Africa, covering 80 political parties across 25 nations.

- **Primary Brand Red**: `#990000` (headings, accents)
- **Secondary Teal**: `#298c8c` (subtitles, secondary metrics)

::: {.ppadem-card}
### [Capacity Building]{.highlight-gold}

## Workstreams Overview

| Workstream | Area | Focus |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **1** | Governance | Transparency & campaign accountability |
| **2** | Institutions | Credible and well-administered elections |
| **3** | Inclusion | Youth & women participation in politics |

## Code & Data Analysis

```r
# Visualising party competition indicators
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(party_data, aes(x = year, y = competitiveness, color = region)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#990000", "#298c8c", "#f1a226")) +
  theme_minimal()
```
